user.title: Where do you live?
user.description: Corrente works out your real electricity price and tells you when it pays to switch things on. Missing something? [Suggest a change]({issues_url}). Corrente is free — [buy us a coffee]({donate_url}) ☕

italy.title: Your electricity contract
italy.description: Corrente works out your price from your contract and the Italian time bands (F1, F2, F3), or from GME's PUN Index plus your spread. [Suggest a change]({issues_url}).

prices_single.title: Prices per kWh
prices_single.description: Enter the energy prices from your bill, in €/kWh (for example 0.1250). Not sure where to find them? [Ask here]({issues_url}).

prices_two_bands.title: Prices per kWh
prices_two_bands.description: Enter the energy prices from your bill, in €/kWh (for example 0.1250). Not sure where to find them? [Ask here]({issues_url}).

prices_three_bands.title: Prices per kWh

ch_search.title: Your municipality
ch_search.description: Type the name of your municipality. Corrente looks up your grid operator in ElCom's open data.

ch_operator.title: Choose your grid operator
ch_operator.description: More than one result: pick your municipality and grid operator.

ch_url.title: Link to the tariff file
ch_url.description: {operator} has not published a readable tariff file (ElCom lists: {elcom_url}). Paste the link to the operator's tariff JSON file if you have it, or [tell us]({issues_url}) and we'll add it.

ch_tariff.title: Your tariff
ch_tariff.description: Choose your energy tariff from {operator}. Dynamic tariffs are listed when the operator publishes their prices through the standard API (for example EKZ, Groupe E); tariffs that can't be calculated are not listed.

ch_grid.title: Grid and fees
ch_grid.description: Corrente suggests the grid tariff and the regional fees that go with "{electricity}". Check them against your bill.

prices_pun.title: PUN-indexed contract
prices_pun.description: Your price is the GME wholesale price (PUN Index or your zone) plus the spread on your bill. Source: GME. [Ask here]({issues_url}) if unsure.

data.losses: Grid losses (if your contract applies them)

init.description: What do you want to change? Missing something or found a mistake? [Suggest a change]({issues_url}).

meter.title: Energy meter
meter.description: Choose the sensor that counts your consumption in kWh (for example your smart meter or the energy dashboard's grid consumption). Corrente prices every kWh at the moment it is used. Leave empty to turn costs off.

appliance.title: Appliance duration
appliance.description: How long the appliance you want to start at the cheapest time usually runs (dishwasher about 2 h, washing machine 1.5 h, electric car 4 h).
